items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You remember that? I played there the night they murdered Sullivan, Temptations. ... Sullivan was older; what was Mr. Sullivan's first name? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember.

ctx.x: That was around about forty two or three or something like that because I remember the war was going on.
When Reg booked me, I didn't get back in there anymore until in the fifties, I played the 5-4 Ballroom. You remember that?
I played there the night they murdered Sullivan, Temptations. We got up to Monterey, California the next night and they killed him the next night in the 5-4 that night. That was in 1968, I guess.
